caption: The drawing shows two rectangular swatches of woven fabric placed vertically, one above the other, on a beige background. The upper swatch has a tartan or plaid pattern composed of horizontal and vertical stripes in blue, brown, and red, with fringed edges. The lower swatch features a striped pattern with alternating lines of red, blue, and white, also with fringed edges. Both swatches have a textured appearance indicative of woven material. Toward the lower right area of the background, the name “PAUL KELLEY” is printed in small, uppercase letters.
